1.text: Gusenga kwa Dawidi.Uwiteka, ntegera ugutwi unsubirize,Kuko ndi umunyamubabaro n'umukene.

2.text: Rindira umutima wanjye kuko ndi umukunzi wawe,Mana yanjye, kiza umugaragu wawe ukwiringira.

3.text: Mwami, mbabaririra,Kuko ari wowe ntakira umunsi ukīra.

4.text: Wishimishiriza umutima w'umugaragu wawe,Kuko ari wowe Mwami ncururira umutima.

5.text: Kuko wowe Mwami uri mwiza, witeguye kubabarira,Kandi wuzuye imbabazi ku bakwambaza bose.

6.text: Uwiteka, tegera ugutwi gusenga kwanjye,Tyariza ugutwi ijwi ryo kwinginga kwanjye.

7.text: Ku munsi w'amakuba yanjye no ku w'ibyago byanjye nzakwambaza,Kuko uzansubiza.

8.text: Mwami, mu bigirwamana nta gihwanye nawe,Kandi nta mirimo ihwanye n'iyawe.

9.text: Mwami, amahanga yose waremye azaza,Akwikubite imbere akuramye,Kandi bazahimbaza izina ryawe.

10.text: Kuko ukomeye kandi ukora ibitangaza,Ni wowe Mana wenyine.

11.text: Uwiteka, ujye unyigisha inzira yawe,Nanjye nzajya ngendera mu murava wawe.Teraniriza hamwe ibiri mu mutima wanjye,Ngo wubahe izina ryawe.

12.text: Mwami Mana yanjye, nzagushimisha umutima wanjye wose,Nzahimbaza izina ryawe iteka ryose.

13.text: Kuko imbabazi ungirira ari nyinshi,Kandi wakijije ubugingo bwanjye,Ntibwajya ikuzimu ko hasi.

14.text: Mana, abibone bampagurukiye,Iteraniro ry'abanyarugomo ryashatse ubugingo bwanjye,Batagushyize imbere yabo.

15.text: Ariko wowe Mwami,Uri Imana y'ibambe n'imbabazi,Itinda kurakara,Ifite kugira neza kwinshi n'umurava mwinshi.

16.text: Unkebuke umbabarire,Uhe umugaragu wawe imbaraga zawe,Ukize umwana w'umuja wawe.

17.text: Unyereke ikimenyetso cy'ibyiza,Kugira ngo abanyanga bakirebe bamware,Kuko wowe Uwiteka, untabaye ukamara umubabaro.
